aggregate.note: FP = detections factually wrong per code review (session_fixation on logout functions that do invalidate). Factually-true detections not in the gold list are 'unlabeled' and excluded from precision — mirrors v5 annotation_issues handling. Matching is strict-localization: a finding counts as detected only when ITS function carries the corresponding rule; the handleRequest aggregator fallback applies only to functions absent from the scan. Ownership findings on delete functions are detected for styles B/C (validateSession/verifyToken auth naming) but not A/D (getUser/getCurrentUser) — a real localization gap of the current detector.
